technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.sonic_sw: On G: for 4 s you stand almost still and weave your body from side to side too fast to hit, leaving afterimages. Every blow and every shot aimed at you misses, costing 2.5 ki each, until you run out of ki. Swinging or charging ends it. A slipped blow from your meditation dodge or silver instinct plays a single quick sway too. 20 ki, 10 s to recharge.
